hero.name: Pratik Santosh Akole
hero.bio: I turn messy, large-scale product and sales data into clean, decision-ready insight — through SQL, Python, Power BI and Excel, with a growing toolkit of AI-driven automation.

about.summary: I'm a Data Analyst with 2+ years of experience in data quality management, validation and reporting across e-commerce catalog and product data. My core stack is SQL, Excel, Power BI and Python (Pandas) — covering the full path from raw data cleaning to interactive dashboards and stakeholder reporting. I hold a PG Certification in AI & Machine Learning and a BE in Electronics & Telecommunication, and I was recognised with the eClerx Values Award (Dec 2025) for excellence in project delivery.

points: Audited and cleaned 10,000+ product records per cycle, resolving data inconsistencies and lifting catalog accuracy by an estimated 15–20%
Led category and taxonomy mapping for the product catalog, improving searchability and reducing misclassified listings by roughly 10%
Built and enforced a QC checklist for product data, cutting recurring data errors flagged in downstream review by an estimated 20%
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to standardize data validation rules, reducing manual rework time
Awarded the eClerx Values Award (Dec 2025) for exceptional commitment & excellence
Analysed large product datasets to identify catalog quality gaps, driving data enrichment initiatives that improved listing completeness
Owned end-to-end data cleaning and preprocessing workflows, improving dataset reliability ahead of reporting cycles
Ran quality checks across multiple datasets, reducing the data inconsistency rate by an estimated 15%
Designed and maintained Power BI dashboards used by the team to track weekly performance and support decision-making
Delivered structured reports to stakeholders, supporting faster, data-backed business decisions
Conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA) on multiple datasets, surfacing trends that improved data accuracy
Cleaned and processed data from multiple sources to prepare it for analysis
Built and tested basic predictive models to support analytical use cases
